bibl.title: Palm Sunday
Hymn 53 on the Reception of Our Saviour Jesus Christ

noteGrp.note: A Syriac liturgical hymn for Palm Sunday on the mystery of Christ’s humanization and entry into Jerusalem. It is hymn 53 in Brooks’s Palm Sunday sequence. It belongs to the Palm Sunday sequence numbered 51–57 in Brooks’s edition of the Syriac Hymns of Severus of Antioch and Others in Patrologia Orientalis VI.1. Listed under the subheading "Again Hymns on the Reception of our Savior Jesus Christ." Brooks numbers this as 52.

bibl.note: Brooks numbers this text as hymn 53. No individual author is encoded because the hymn is transmitted in the collection entitled Hymns of Severus of Antioch and Others, and modern scholarship cautions that individual authorship within the collection is not always recoverable. Brooks based his Syriac text on British Library Add. 17134 and Add. 18816, the two extant manuscripts of Jacob of Edessa’s revision identified by Juckel.

note.quote: ܩܕܡ ܟܠܗ ܥܡܗ ܪܒ ܗܘ ܛ̇ܒ ܥ݀ܘܡܩܐ ܕܪܐܙܐ ܩܕܝܫܐ ܘܦܐܐ ܠܐܠܗܐ ܕܡܬܒܪܢܫܢܘܠܟ ܡܫܝܚܐ
Before all the people - Very great is the depth of the holy God-befitting mystery of thy Humanization, Christ.
ܡܒܪܟܐ ܐܝܬܝܟ ܗ̇ܘ ܕܐܬ݂ܐ ܒܡܘܟܟܐ ܘܥܬܝܕ ܬܘܒ ܕܢܐܬܐ ܒܫܘ̣ܒܚܐ
Blessed art thou that hast come in humility and shalt come again in glory.
